_about: Every reason Outgrow plans a house that the game causes, switched off (the user, 23 Oct: 'what are all the reasons we would outgrow a building for? We should just have toggles for all of that'; 'on a city where you're not building and there's no empty zoning, nothing should be outgrowing'). In their city '123' (read-only: loaded, never saved; 'Outgrow new buildings' off as saved) every garden is first planned again with this build (Redo) and checked (outgrowCheck A). Then with 'levels up', 'the game changes a building' and 'the game removes a building nearby' off: 45 s paused (baseline; set first, so nothing waits for the running stretches), 45 s and 45 s running (close-ups of two level-ups kept), check B; then the player's bulldozer takes some houses near a garden (their neighbours must still be planned: the bulldozer step logs how many it put in line) and 20 s more. Read plansWritten and putInLine of each stretch (nothing should be planned but a building site on garden land or a clash), frames over 50 / 100 ms and collections against the paused stretch, and the checks A->B (open and hidden fence, bare lawn).
